name: Mary Worthington no Kodomo-tachi
original_name: メアリ・ウォージントンの子どもたち
source:
When the rain gradually turns into ice rain. Swim through the blue world and you'll reach the Mary Worthington Gymnasium. Through a mysterious experience like a daydream with the boys you meet there, let's go find your wavering "truth."

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6873]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
当雨渐渐变成冰雨时。游过蓝色世界，你将到达玛丽沃辛顿体育馆。通过与在那里遇到的男孩们一起进行像白日梦一样的神秘经历，让我们去寻找你摇摆不定的“真相”。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6873]NovelGame[/url]]
